description: Get the file/PDF attachments of a single Canton Improvement Proposal (CIP): supporting documents and signed-vote-record PDFs, with filename, page count, URL, and the full text CCPEDIA has extracted from each. Many older CIPs publish the proposal ITSELF as a PDF and leave only a header block in markdown, so for those this returns the actual proposal text and get_cip returns the index entry. For the parsed who-voted-how breakdown use get_cip_votes. Canton ecosystem only. Not Cardano or other 'CIP' schemes.
name: get_cip_attachments
